title: Dividend Scale Size Schedule: Larger Whole Life Insurance Policies Under the Accumulate Option
content:
The dividend placed on deposit on an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy is raised for a large policy, judged by the base face plus the paid-up additions face that the purchase entries on the policy ledger total.

| Base face plus ledger-totalled additions face (USD) | Dividend placed on deposit raised by |
|---|---|
| 250000 or more | 4% (0.04) |
| 100000 or more, below 250000 | 2% (0.02) |
| Below 100000 | Not raised |

**How the percentage works.** The percentage is a share of the dividend being placed on deposit. Percentage changes to the amount placed on deposit are added together and applied once to the dividend, never one on top of another, and the result is rounded half up to the cent once.

**Size edges (hypothetical).**

| Base face | Additions face from purchase entries | Total | Raise |
|---|---|---|---|
| 240000.00 | 10000.00 | 250000.00 | 4% |
| 240000.00 | 9999.99 | 249999.99 | 2% |
| 95000.00 | 5000.00 | 100000.00 | 2% |
| 95000.00 | 4999.00 | 99999.00 | None |

On a dividend of 1339.20 raised by 2% alone, 1339.20 times 1.02 is 1365.984, placed on deposit as 1365.98.
